business_summary: Creative Newtech Limited distributes information technology (IT), gaming, imaging, and lifestyle products in India and internationally. It operates through the Brand Business and Market Entry Specialist segments. The company provides monitors and televisions; video door phones; smart cutting machines, materials, and tools; air purifier, home audio, laptop enhancement and mobility products, and structured cabling systems; storage/memory cards; cameras; servers and processors; turntables and speakers; imaging cameras; PCs; memory, storage, graphic, and networking products; motherboards; projectors, 3D glasses, and IFPDs; computers and accessories; mobile covers and accessories; tablets; smart rings; surveillance and cybersecurity products; monitoring products; and drone technology products. It offers its products through channel partners, e-commerce channels, large format retails, and specialized retailers. The company was formerly known as Creative Peripherals and Distribution Limited and changed its name to Creative Newtech Limited in August 2021. Creative Newtech Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
